bio: Associated with Chief Keef and Fredo Santana. He killed Javan, shot Fathead eight times in the head, killed TuTu with multiple shots continuing to fire after TuTu was already dead, and shot at TuTu's funeral. He formed a shooting duo with Tay600 against STL.EBT.
One of the four founding members of the 600. Close to Lil Durk.
Before joining the 600, he was affiliated with the MOB and close with Beans and Brick. He had dealings with K.I. of STL/EBT.
An OG of Brick City and one of its last active members. His death was one of the reasons for the 600's decline.

From the Geo Drive area, associated with Lil Steve, Lil Boo, and L'A Capone. He was involved in multiple violent incidents including hitting TTB Nez with a chair, and being chased by TB of Tyquan World and Wooski. He fired on the MOB during Steve Day 2018 and caught young Lil Moe but released him.
One of the four founding members of the 600.
From the Brick$quad 069 and close to Waldo. He fired on the MOB during Steve Day 2018 with Jusblow and Memo. He fought Cdai of the 600 and Lil Mick of the 051 Young Money in prison.
He killed his girlfriend and brother, then shot his girlfriend's mother. He also shot at TuTu's funeral in 2011.

Originally from Brick City and a former Gangster Disciple. He had lived in Evans Mobb territory with family connections there. He was close to D-Thang and was present when D-Thang was killed, coming under fire himself. He is currently close to Drake.
From the THF 44 area and remains close to them.
He triggered the war against MoeTown in 2009.
Considered one of the bosses of No Luv City. He controlled part of WIIIC City in the early 2000s.
A rapper who started as an affiliate of the Fly Boy Gang and spent time with STL/EBT. He was present when BossTop of O'Block was robbed.
He killed Dell at a party and was found and killed minutes later.
He was killed outside Chicago and outside the context of gang warfare. His killer was incarcerated and convicted for his murder.
He was killed by his own allies.
Close to CoKilla and D.Rose of the 600.
Close to D.Rose and signed to Savage Squad Records.
A member of Doughboyz Cashout, he is considered by many a legend of Detroit.
He was a lieutenant of the PA Boys in Atlanta.
A Crip affiliated with Glo Gang, though he never signed an official contract.
A rapper who was close to Scrapp.
He was killed after a 30,000 dollar hit was placed on him by W.B 057.
His death was avenged by his police officer cousin Kasper, who leaked information to LordsVille members about the killers and covered up their crimes against the W.B.
He died outside of gang warfare.
A hitman from Dearborn who killed Gary Miller for 30,000 dollars.
A rapper.
O'Block was named in his honor. He was killed with his own weapon by K.I. of STL.EBT and beaten by Meechie for insulting Tooka. He was memorialized in tracks by Edai, Chief Keef, and BossTop.
An OG of WIIIC City. He killed Brian Thomas of MurderVille, STL/EBT on August 28, 1998. BossTop has mentioned him.
He fought multiple times with Aero of the 051 Young Money, who eventually cooperated against him.
He killed Goonie Looney and died weeks later.
At age 15, he was shot seven times in 2020 and then beaten to death, dying in the hospital.
He killed his friend Huncho of the same set.
A high-ranking member of the gang.
